2607.20926.title: SciExplore: Evaluating Autonomous Agents from Scientific Navigation to Information Integration
2607.20926.paper_summary: Scientific research involves complex information-seeking and reasoning workflows across heterogeneous sources. However, existing benchmarks primarily emphasize general-domain retrieval or static scientific question answering, and therefore fail to assess key capabilities required in realistic scientific research workflows. We introduce SciExplore, a benchmark designed to evaluate scientific information-seeking and reasoning capabilities of LLMs and agents. SciExplore comprises four task types covering 103 expert-curated tasks across more than ten scientific disciplines: scientific database navigation, ambiguous literature retrieval, missing reference completion, and cross-source structured knowledge synthesis, which probe progressively higher-level abilities from entity-level reasoning and document-level identification to evidence-level grounding and domain-level synthesis. We evaluate over ten state-of-the-art LLMs and autonomous agents on SciExplore, revealing substantial performance gaps with performance degrading sharply as task complexity increases and extremely low accuracy on the most challenging structured synthesis tasks. These results highlight significant limitations of current models and agents in realistic scientific information-seeking scenarios.
2607.20926.paper_summary_zh: 科學研究涉及跨異構來源的複雜資訊尋求和推理工作流程。<lb/>然而，現有的基準主要強調一般領域的檢索或靜態科學問題回答，因此無法評估在現實科學研究工作流程中所需的關鍵能力。<lb/>我們引入了 SciExplore，一個旨在評估 LLM 和代理的科學資訊尋求和推理能力的基準。<lb/>SciExplore 包含四種類型的任務，涵蓋了超過十個科學學科的 103 個專家策劃的任務：科學數據庫導航、模糊文獻檢索、缺失參考補全和跨來源結構化知識綜合，這些任務逐步探測從實體層級推理和文件層級識別到證據層級基礎和領域層級綜合的更高層次能力。<lb/>我們在 SciExplore 上評估了十多個最先進的 LLM 和自主代理，揭示了顯著的性能差距，隨著任務複雜度的增加，性能急劇下降，並且在最具挑戰性的結構化綜合任務上準確率極低。<lb/>這些結果突顯了當前模型和代理在現實科學資訊尋求場景中的重大限制。
